findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_workflow_draft" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Checks a Nityaflow workflow design and keeps it for 14 days behind a link. Opening the link shows the workflow in the Nityaflow editor with every step filled in…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "agent_payment_check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Before an AI agent pays, checks the proposed payment against the person's mandate (who allowed it, limits per payment and per period, allowed shops and UPI IDs, end date) and against what the person actually asked for (items, quantities, budget, shop). It works the total out again from the cart line" → after: "When the user asks for a payment check, checks a proposed AI-agent payment against the person's mandate (who allowed it, limits per payment and per period, allowed shops and UPI IDs, end date) and against what the person actually asked for (items, quantities, budget, shop). It works the total out ag"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
